_about: The town and shops prototypes (proto-town, 2 Nov 2026; js/town-proto/; designs build/reports/designs/town-map.md and shops.md): the words and lines the four games need that the family has not recorded yet. Every one is an English placeholder (kutchi: null), to record; build/lang/import_modes.mjs turns each word into a to-record entry and each line into an engine meaning, so the games ask the language engine for them like any other line and it answers with the grey-italic English. Nothing here is Kutchi. Re-run node build/lang/import_all.mjs after a change.

ph-market.src: bajaar is heard inside 'go to the market' (bajaar mai vaan, a handout draft Mum hasn't confirmed): to record as a word

ph-library.src: likely an English loan in the family's Kutchi: Mum to say

ph-bread.src: Mum: which word the family uses for a bakery loaf (maani is chapati)

ph-paisa.src: the price's unit word: Mum to say which the family uses (paisa, shilling ...)

map-guide.e: Send each one where they want to go.

map-go.e: I want to go to the {x}.

serve-guide.e: Help me at the stall: give each one what they ask for.

picky-guide.e: Pick the one I want, then give it to me.

pay-guide.e: Count out the coins, then give them to him.
